note: Kedah's FY2021 report (CMD.42.2022 J10) prints its 2020 column one row out of place: its 31.74 against the Concurrent List grant is Caruman Untuk Pembayaran Pinjaman, and the grant's own 37.51 sits against Lain-Lain Levi.
